CloudShift.title: CloudShift
CloudShift.description: Medical or administrative staff shift stored in Firestore and synchronized with local Room database.

userId.description: Authenticated owner UID of the shift record.

staffName.description: Full name of the medical or administrative staff member.

department.description: Hospital unit, ward, or administrative department.

category.description: Category of the shift: MEDICAL or ADMIN.

shiftStatus.description: Current operational status of the shift.

shiftTimeLabel.description: Scheduled shift time window and duration.

dateLabel.description: Readable date or shift turn label.

locationRoom.description: Physical wing, room, or bed range.

permissionLevel.description: Real-time clinical or administrative permission level.

notes.description: Clinical handoff notes or voice command transcript.

voiceTranscript.description: Raw spoken Speech-to-Text command used to create the shift.

isOnCall.description: Whether the staff member is on-call (sobreaviso).

createdViaVoice.description: Whether this shift was created via Speech-to-Text voice command.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation (must use FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update (must use FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

CloudClinicalCase.title: CloudClinicalCase
CloudClinicalCase.description: Traceable clinical decision and TCRIA governance record.

userId.description: Authenticated owner UID of the clinical case record.

projectClinicAnchor.description: RULE 1.1: Linked clinic or project anchor name.

clinicUf.description: Two-letter state code of the clinic.

caseReference.description: Patient alias or de-identified case reference code.

declaredPurpose.description: RULE 4.1: Declared purpose of the clinical decision record.

contextScope.description: RULE 1.2: Clinical context, scope, and conditions.

evidencias.description: RULE 2.1: Clinical evidence, exams, and observations.

raciocinio.description: RULE 2.2: Clinical reasoning connecting evidence to decision.

decisao.description: RULE 3.1: Documented clinical conduct or decision.

deidentificationConfirmed.description: Whether de-identification of sensitive PII was confirmed.

governanceReport.description: Diagnostic report from TCRIA governance gates.

createdViaVoice.description: Whether the clinical case was dictated via Speech-to-Text.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation (must use FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update (must use FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/shifts/{shiftId}.description: Per-user isolated collection of medical and administrative staff shifts.

/users/{userId}/clinical_cases/{caseId}.description: Per-user isolated collection of TCRIA-governed clinical decision records.
